fixes.explanation: Samuel, huh? I see you reaching for a big name, friend, and I respect the confidence. But he's not in this verse. The text says the instruments were the ones King David had made for giving thanks to the LORD (2 Chronicles 7:6). David made them, and David praised with them.

A closer look? Friend, I love the thinking, but nobody's fighting for a front-row seat here. The text says the bronze altar Solomon had made could not hold all these offerings (2 Chronicles 7:7). That's a lot of offerings, and the altar just ran out of room. So Solomon consecrated the middle of the courtyard in front of the house of the LORD.
